title: Yai Nee Romba Azhaga Irukey
desc: Four youngsters go through various ups and downs in their lives when they experience unrequited love and encounter rejection.

title: Vaanchinathan
desc: Vanchinathan, a straightforward policeman, exploits the loopholes in the law to eliminate the criminals who go unpunished.

title: Pasumpon
desc: Thangapandi stays with his grandfather after the birth of his stepbrother Sellasamy. He is jealous of him and leaves his mother after an unexpected incident leaves him feeling unwanted.

title: Mirattal
desc: Ashok falls in love with Deepika, who turns out to be his employer Shankar's sister. However, trouble arises when Shankar's rival attacks Deepika.

title: Karuppan
desc: A bold act during a traditional bull-taming event secures Karuppan's marriage, yet jealousy and betrayal slowly unravel the trust within the family.
